description: The Geophysical Center of the Russian Academy of Sciences publishes ROSA, a spatial database of the world’s largest oil and gas fields. The ESDB landing page identifies static and dynamic field parameters, creation in 2016 and publication in 2019, with ArcGIS Explorer, ArcMap and ArcGIS Earth access links. Its CC BY-NC 4.0 licence permits free noncommercial reuse. The internationally scoped collection can inform resource-location assumptions and historical development scenarios for energy-supply simulations. It covers selected large fields, not a complete global asset inventory, and its stated geographic bounds omit parts of the world. The live map service was not tested numerically. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: ROSA global oil and gas fields GIS
